contexts.text: Cursed is the man who... maketh flesh his arm... arm = power.

In the World of Spirits there sometimes comes into view a naked arm, in which there is such strength that it can break the bones to pieces, and as it were pound the very marrow to nothing; and such terror is struck by it that their hearts melt; yea, there actually is such power in it. AC 4934. AC 4935. HH 231:end. SE 881. SE 1754, Explained.
The hand = power... the arm, power still greater.
He shall come in strength, and His arm having dominion for Him () = that by His Own power He will conquer the Hells. AC 1793:2. AC 1813. AE 629:10.
Under Heat, see this reference.
Arm = power. AC 2072. AC 3105:end. AC 3322:2. AC 4933, Illustrated. AC 7518.
The breast and arms (of the statue seen by Nebuchadnezzar) = spiritual or rational things, which are silver. AC 3021:8.
The arms and feet (of the man seen by Daniel) = the exterior things of the Word, which are the sense of the letter...
Under Infant, see this reference.
Under Hand, see this reference. AC 9836:2. DLW 220.
On the correspondence of the arms, etc. General article.
I have seen this naked arm twice; and from it I was given to know that the arms signify strength, and the hands, power. Heat was also felt exhaling from that arm.
The arms of his hands are made strong = the power of the forces of fighting. AE 357:2. AE 448:6.

I will redeem you with a stretched out arm = leading out of Hell by Divine power... That a stretched out arm is omnipotence, or Divine power, is because by an arm, when it appears outstretched in the Heavens, is represented power from the Divine; but when not outstretched, but bent, there is represented power in a general sense. Illustrated. AC 7673:3, Illustrated.
The arm of Jehovah is the Lord as to the Divine Human.
In the greatness of Thy arm () = from omnipotence. Arm = power, but when said of the Divine, it = omnipotence. AE 406:6.
To make flesh his arm = to confide in his Own power; therefore to eat the flesh of his arm = to confide in himself. AC 10283:7.
To break the arms (of Pharaoh) () = to dissipate their forces.
Truth Divine, or the Lord in ultimates, is meant by the arms and feet as the splendour of burnished bronze ().
The staves (of the ark) had relation to the arms with man.
Good is to truth as the body to the arms and feet.
The branches of the candlestick have a similar signification to the arms and hands of man...
The arm that performed salvation for Him, and upon which they will confide = Own power, by which He subjugated the Hells.
The wheels of the cherubs have a similar signification to that of the arms and feet with man: namely, the power of acting and advancing; which is of truth from good.
Their arm has not saved them, but Thy right hand, and Thine arm... ()... arm = strength.
By the breast and arms (of the statue) is signified the second state of the Church.
His arm drying shall dry up (). Arm, here, = the power of truth applied to confirm evil... See below, at AE 600:17.
Arm = the power that is of truth from good.
The horns of the altar also have relation to the arms and hands with man, by which is also signified truth in its power in ultimates, or extremes.
Those who, within the Church, have denied the Lord... have their arms hanging down and dangling as though they were devoid of force in the joints. SE 6025:2.
The Ultimate or First Heaven forms the feet down to the soles, and also the arms down to the fingers; for the arms and hands are ultimates of man, although at the sides.
They who are in the arms and hands are in the power of truth from good.
Hence it is that... by the arms and hands is signified the power of truth.

In the greatest power are they who constitute the arms in the Grand Man, because they who are there, are in truths more than others, and into their truths there flows in good from the universal Heaven; the power of the whole man also goes into the arms, and the whole body exercises its force through them. Hence it is that by arms and hands in the Word there is signified power.
Her husband had been... as it were her arm...
They shall eat [every] man the flesh of his own arm ()... = that evil will extinguish all truth, and falsity all good... The flesh of the arm is the power of good through truth. AE 617:29.
By the breast and arms of silver is signified the Ancient Church.
(Gad) seizeth the arm, also the crown of the head ()... = that he is nourished by outward and inward truths... for the arm, and crown of the head, in sacrifices, signified these things.

Underneath are the arms of the world ()... The arms of the world are Divine truths where men are; the truths of the sense of the letter of the Word are what are meant by the arms of the world; for that sense is the very strength itself of Divine Truth; arms signify strength.

Woe to the shepherd of naught that deserteth the flock! the sword upon his arm, and upon his right eye, his arm drying shall dry up ()... By the sword upon his arm is signified falsity destroying all the good of the will... That they must be deprived of all good and truth is signified by his arm drying shall dry up, and his right eye darkening shall be darkened. See AC 10061:4.
By the arm of His strength, etc. (), is meant the Lord as to Divine Truth, thus the Divine Truth proceeding from the Lord.
With whom My hand shall be firm, Mine arm also shall strengthen him ()... The hand = the omnipotence of truth from good, and the arm, the omnipotence of good through truth.
